evidence: Hashed every file in both the frozen task (.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/task) and the live projects/kittle-matter-chat. Each has exactly 32 files. All 32 match manifest.json inputs.task sha256 values, with 0 extra, 0 missing and 0 empty files. git ls-files lists the same 32 paths, and there are no empty directories. The tree maps exactly onto the closed list in staged-task-contract.md:5-30. Root: instruction.md, task.toml. environment/: Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and instructions/{conversations,integration,walls-and-retention}.md ('one or more operating notes'). solution/: solve.sh, plus app/** = package.json, server.js, public/{app.js,index.html,styles.css,transcript.css} and seed/seed_data.json. tests/: Dockerfile, test.sh, scoring.toml, app_context.md, .dockerignore, gates/{render,constraints}/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, scored/{functional,polish,visual}/{judge.toml,prompt.md} and tools/{score.py,restart_mcp.py}. Every required item in Deterministic Checks row 25 (check-required-files.py) is present, including tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py and the non-empty tests/app_context.md flagged in deterministic-checks.md:38. Nothing on the must-be-absent list (contract:32) is present: no tests/reward.toml, no stray tests/ entry, no NOTES.md/SOLUTION.md/.env, zips, xlsx, trial runs, node_modules, *.db/*.db-wal, lockfile, __pycache__, .DS_Store/editor backups or coverage.json. solution/app/seed/seed_data.json is a byte-identical copy of environment/assets/seed_data.json (both f69616e2...). It is a deliberate part of the golden app: server.js:29 lists it as the first fallback before /assets/seed_data.json, and solve.sh:5 copies app/. into /app. It therefore falls under app/** rather than counting as a backup. It also matches the workbook Internal sheet E51 and the skill's known false positive ('task-specific seed_data.json ... report as Note, not a blocker'). Compared with projects/webdev-task-template, the only structural differences are task-specific: the operating notes are named per topic instead of notes.md, and the golden app adds the public/ assets and package.json. Side observation, not a task defect: during this review a transient file .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/task/grep.exe.stackdump appeared in the first listing and was gone a few seconds later. It is a crash dump from a concurrent reviewer's grep.exe whose cwd was the frozen snapshot. It is not in manifest inputs, not in projects/kittle-matter-chat, and not tracked by git.
notes: Broken-app and conforming-alternative probes do not apply to this structural row. The counterexample that matters is a packaging one: if a ZIP were built from the .qc-cache snapshot (or the live folder) while concurrent tools are dropping *.stackdump or other residue there, the shipped archive would fail this row. Before packaging, the owner should zip from projects/kittle-matter-chat and recheck the archive listing against the 32 manifest paths. This is a process caution, not a current defect. Duplicated seed (solution/app/seed/seed_data.json) = Note-level per workbook internal annotation and skill known-false-positive; not a blocker.
